title: The absorber files the same defect again and again: one SIGTERM temp-tree failure became five backlog ticks
body: zv1, mtq, 0wp, 1zw and bsn were filed by five workers over 2.5 hours for one failure of TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote; a promoted finding leaves the drafts workers see, and nothing checks open ticks the run itself promoted. 8d6 (4230b469) fixed it and the test passes 3/3 at the tip, so the five can close as fixed. Deduplicate a new finding against open ticks the run promoted (same demonstrating_check or test name) before filing.
